北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，但体感稍凉，记得添衣保暖，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels chilly. Dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有霾且风大，体感很冷，注意防寒保暖，戴好口罩！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has haze and strong winds. It feels very cold, keep warm and wear a mask!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，体感舒适。记得添件薄外套，注意防潮。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool. Feel comfortable, but a light jacket might be nice.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴天风大，体感稍凉。记得添衣，小心风吹感冒！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny but windy and a bit cool. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗温暖，体感舒适。昼夜温差大，别忘早晚添衣。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm, quite pleasant. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感微凉。出门别忘带件外套，小心着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels cool. Don't forget a jacket when going out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感较凉。出行请戴好口罩，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze and feels cool. Wear a mask when going out and stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感偏凉。出门多穿点，注意防风保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels cool. Dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感微凉。多穿衣服，小心湿冷感冒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels cool. Dress warmly to avoid the damp chill.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，但体感温度低，风力较大。注意保暖，小心感冒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels very cold with strong winds. Keep warm to avoid a cold!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感凉爽。记得穿暖和，小心湿冷入侵。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels cool. Remember to dress warmly against the damp chill.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，但极度严寒。请务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold. Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，气温很低。多穿厚衣服，小心防寒保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but very cold. Wear thick clothes and stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗舒适，但风力较大。早晚温差大，别忘添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant but windy. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感宜人。早晚凉，记得带件外套哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels pleasant. It's cool in the morning and evening, bring a jacket.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感偏凉。出门注意保暖，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cool. Stay warm when going out to avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感寒冷。外出务必多穿，谨防风寒感冒！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels very cold. Be sure to bundle up, beware of wind chill!
